title: OSC bridge
description: Where to listen for OSC, where to send tally and programme, and who is allowed to send.

listen.title: Listen on
listen.description: Address and port to receive OSC on. A bare port means every address on this machine. 9000 is what TouchOSC, Open Stage Control and QLab offer first.

send_to.title: Send to
send_to.description: Where tally and programme go, as address:port. Empty means the bridge only listens, which costs nothing.

send_tally.title: Send tally
send_tally.description: Send <prefix>/tally/<source id> whenever the tally changes: 1 on programme, 2 on preview, 0 off, with the word beside the number.

send_program.title: Send programme and states
send_program.description: Send <prefix>/program on every take, and <prefix>/source/<id>/state and <prefix>/output/<id>/state as they change.

prefix.title: Outgoing prefix
prefix.description: Put in front of every address this plugin sends. Leave it empty for bare addresses.

allow_from.title: Accept only from
allow_from.description: Addresses allowed to send commands. Empty accepts anything that can reach the port, which is right on a show LAN and wrong on a network you do not own.
